entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production furniture collection reference for a portrait mobile storybook merchant game, level 1. Palette and construction: pale cream cottage shop, lightly waxed honey oak, dark walnut tenons, sage inset panels, practical simple joinery. Create one refined collection sheet on warm neutral ivory: a weapons rack, a potion-bottle-shaped merchandise cabinet, a FULL SPHERICAL spirit capture orb shaped display cabinet (sphere silhouette intact, inset display in front), an ore-and-timber material cabinet if appropriate, plus a matching wall clock, framed landscape picture, small upholstered sofa and potted plant. Every freestanding object stands on ONE square grid tile; wall objects shown separately below. Finely crafted rounded wood joinery, natural artisan materials, precise copper/brass details, readable THIN BLACK CONTOUR LINES. Consistent 3/4 orthographic views, objects clearly separated, clear silhouettes, beautifully crafted purposeful decorative elements. Retail nameplates must attach to cabinet tops, never float. Actual merchandise shapes readable: potions are bottles, weapons distinct swords, materials logs and iron ore. Include a small three-state strip below showing THE SAME weapon rack fully stocked, half sold, completely empty. NO letters, NO numerals, NO text, NO watermark, NO characters. Refer to an artisan mobile low-poly model look with tasteful illustrated surface texture, not photoreal clutter. Maintain small readable construction details while usable in a game.
